name: stage1_v1
description: Stage 1 frozen on PMC dev: rules + numbers + LLM reader. No tuning after this point.

llm.server: vLLM on the same node, 127.0.0.1 only (scripts/sol_run.sh)

dev_results.source: PMC dev, 64 cases (optimistic: chosen on dev)

known_limitations: The linker's LLM-choice step is about 51-58% precise on judged dev extras (35/69 pooled over prompt versions; 19/33 for prompt v1); chooser links are graded weak.
Dev numbers are optimistic: prompt, chooser and status policy were chosen on PMC dev.
Hand-checked recall rests on 69 dev terms from one annotator (no agreement measured).
Correct but diagnostically irrelevant findings (e.g. a seasonal allergy) can move a disease rank by several places.
